mapper.select: select p.product_id,p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate, p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type from product p left outer join product_img pi on p.product_id=pi.product_id and pi.product_img_type='메인';

select p.product_id,p.category_id,p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate,p.product_mall_name, p.product_madein,p.product_release,p.product_as_manager_phone,p.product_type,p.product_color, p.product_istoday,p.product_date, pi.product_img_id,pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type from product p left outer join product_img pi on p.product_id = pi.product_id and pi.product_img_type = '메인' where p.product_id=#{product_id};
select pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type,pi.product_img_id,p.product_id from product_img pi join product p on pi.product_id=p.product_id where p.product_id=#{product_id};

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate,p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type,COALESCE(COUNT(op.product_id), 0) as order_count FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' LEFT JOIN orders_products op ON p.product_id = op.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id DESC limit 8

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate,p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type,COALESCE(COUNT(op.product_id), 0) as order_count FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' LEFT JOIN orders_products op ON p.product_id = op.product_id WHERE pi.product_imgurl IS NOT NULL -- 메인 이미지가 있는 상품만 GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id DESC

SELECT p.product_id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.product_price as product_price, p.product_discountrate as product_discountrate, p.product_mall_name as product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl as product_imgurl, pi.product_img_type as product_img_type FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' WHERE p.product_discountrate > 0 ORDER BY p.product_discountrate DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT p.product_id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.product_price as product_price, p.product_discountrate as product_discountrate, p.product_mall_name as product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl as product_imgurl, pi.product_img_type as product_img_type FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' WHERE p.product_discountrate > 0 ORDER BY p.product_discountrate DESC

SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate,p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type,c.category_main,c.category_sub FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.category_id = #{param1};

select pi.pinquiry_content,pi.pinquiry_date,pi.pinquiry_status, pr.preply_content ,pr.preply_date,u.user_id,u.user_nickname from product_inquiry pi left join product_reply pr on pi.pinquiry_id=pr.pinquiry_id left join product p on p.product_id=pi.product_id left join user_detail u on u.user_id=pi.user_id where p.product_id=#{p.product_id};

select p.product_id,p.product_name,p.product_price,p.product_discountrate,p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl,pi.product_img_type,count(r.target_id) as review_count from product p left join product_img pi on p.product_id = pi.product_id and pi.product_img_type = '메인' left join review r on r.target_id=p.product_id and r.target_type = 'SHOP' group by p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_price, p.product_discountrate, p.product_mall_name, pi.product_imgurl, pi.product_img_type order by count(r.target_id) desc;

select r.user_id,r.review_id,r.review_title,r.review_content,r.review_count, r.review_date,r.target_id,r.target_type, u.user_name,u.user_nickname from review r join user_detail u on r.user_id=u.user_id where r.target_id=#{target_id} and target_type='shop';
